name: Retiplex
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Create product video advertisements with AI actors for marketing campaigns. Start from a product link or description, develop the creative brief, choose the actor, and review the voiceover script and storyboard before generating the finished video. Add product photos, footage, supporting characters, and required scenes to shape the ad. Review existing ad projects, track generation progress, and resume supported failed generations. Connect your Retiplex account through OAuth to work with your projects.

limitations_ja: プロジェクトの利用にはRetiplexアカウントのOAuth接続が必要。
